title: Background jobs
help: Copies one selected file into this package and computes its SHA-256. Jobs continue after sign-out; the package keeps the copy and result.
pickerConsent: The selected file is read once with your current DSM sign-in and handed to the background job. No permission is saved.
limits: Up to {size} KB per file, {queue} queued jobs, {seconds} seconds per job.

errors.failed: The request could not be completed. Refresh and try again.
errors.limit-exceeded: The file is larger than the limit.
errors.session_required: Your DSM session expired. Sign in again.
errors.owner-queue-full: Your pending job limit is reached. Wait for a job to finish or cancel one.
errors.owner-quota-exceeded: Your background storage limit is reached. Ask an administrator to clear your old jobs.
errors.identity_unavailable: Your DSM user UID could not be verified. Sign in again or ask an administrator.
errors.schedule-full: The 8-schedule limit is reached. Delete a schedule.
errors.input-unavailable: The private copy is unavailable or changed. Import it again.
errors.unsupported: Background jobs are unavailable. Refresh and try again.

ownerScope: You can see, cancel and download only your own jobs.
adminScope: Administrators can see and cancel every user’s jobs.
ownerLimits: Per user: {jobs} pending jobs and {size} KB of input and reserved result storage.
purgeConfirm: Clear all jobs owned by {user} (UID {uid})? Running jobs are canceled and drained; this removes their saved results.
scheduleHelp: Reprocess a fixed private copy hourly, daily or weekly as the package user. Up to 8 schedules; missed runs are recorded and never replayed.
scheduleConsent: I agree to keep and reprocess this fixed copy as the package user. No new source files or personal ACLs are read.
deleteScheduleConsent: Delete the schedule for {name}? Queued jobs are canceled and running jobs drain. Finished results remain.
enableScheduleConsent: Enable the schedule for {name} with the current worker revision? I agree to reprocess this fixed copy. Past runs will not be replayed.
revisionChanged: The worker revision changed. An administrator must review and explicitly enable this schedule.
unsupported: Background jobs are unavailable. Refresh and try again.
